🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>MEXICO REOPENS OIL FLOW TO BLOCKADED CUBA — VIA PRIVATE COMPANIES TO DODGE TRUMP TARIFF THREATS</u>

Sheinbaum confirmed at Monday's mañanera that Mexico is working to restart fuel exports to Cuba — but routed through Mexican private firms using Havana's newly approved economic-opening laws, not state-owned Pemex, after Trump threatened tariffs on any country supplying the island following the January 3 attack on Venezuela.

"El mecanismo sería a través de empresas particulares que tienen el permiso para llevar el combustible a Cuba," she said. Cuba produces only 40% of the fuel it needs and depends on imports to keep its grid alive. Humanitarian aid continues in parallel.

The blockade tightens. The routes around it multiply.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>HOMICIDES DOWN 46% UNDER SHEINBAUM — MAY 2026 LOWEST MONTHLY LEVEL IN 12 YEARS</u>

Intentional homicides in Mexico fell 46% between September 2024 and May 2026 — from 86.9 daily killings to 47.3 — with May 2026 posting the lowest monthly figure in twelve years.

The Plan Nacional de Atención a las Causas (intelligence work, social investment, federal-state-municipal coordination) is delivering what 20 years of Calderón-Peña Nieto militarized US-aligned drug war could not. Without a single ICE-style raid. Without DEA in command of operations. Without F-35s over Sinaloa.

Sovereignty works. The proof is on the ground.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO LEADS WORLD CUP TOURISM OVER US AND CANADA — VISITORS UP 5.5% WHILE US DROPS 1.7% Tourism Secretary Josefina Rodríguez Zamora: international visitors to Mexico jumped 5.5% Jan-April 2026, while Canada grew 3.5% and the United States fell 1.7%. Match-day hotel occupancy hits 85-90% in Mexico's three host cities versus 35-40% in US and Canadian host cities. FIFA projects 5.5 million total tournament visitors; Mexico already receives roughly 9 million international visitors a month. "México está de moda; no lo digo yo, lo dicen los números, y vamos por más." Trump's "shithole" mythology meeting the numbers — and losing.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>SCJN RULES ABC DAYCARE CRIMES HAVE NO STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS — 49 KIDS KILLED, NEOLIBERAL OUTSOURCING ON TRIAL</u>

The Supreme Court ruled unanimously on June 19 that the 2009 Guardería ABC tragedy — 49 children burned to death in a privately subcontracted IMSS daycare in Hermosillo, Sonora — has no statute of limitations, keeping Sergio Antonio Salazar and other ex-officials on the hook.

Justice Estela Ríos: the tragedy "was a product of a neoliberal model that privatized state daycare services." Sheinbaum on the ruling: "This occurred thanks to the change in the Judicial Power; otherwise it would never have happened."

17 years of dragging the outsourcing model into court — and the reformed Judiciary finally answered.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>KATIA ITZEL GARCÍA — FIRST MEXICAN WOMAN TO REFEREE A MEN'S WORLD CUP MATCH</u>

FIFA designated Mexican ref Katia Itzel García to officiate Tunisia vs Netherlands on June 25 at Kansas City Stadium — making her the third woman in history to lead a men's World Cup match, after France's Stéphanie Frappart at Qatar 2022 and the US's Tori Penso this edition, and the first Mexican woman ever. The same IFFHS that ranked her 6th best globally in 2024 and 2025 and the best in CONCACAF.

Mexico shows up at its own World Cup with quiet, irrefutable excellence — and the misogynist trolls Copred condemned in April are watching her stand in the center circle.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>4T FINES 4 EX-SEGALMEX OFFICIALS 777.8 MILLION PESOS — 10-YEAR BAN FOR DIVERTING FOOD-AID FUNDS</u>

The Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno secretariat plus the Tribunal Federal de Justicia Administrativa hit four directors of Alimentación para el Bienestar — Segalmex's heir agency — with 777.8 million pesos in economic sanctions and 10-year disqualifications for diverting 2019 funds from the Precios de Garantía food-aid program toward the Fertilizers Program and other uses. The same resolution sanctioned 23 additional public servants from CFE, INM, IMSS and Pemex.

No protected ranks. No decade of impunity. The 4T cleans its own house in public — with receipts.

🇲🇽🌎 Mexico will not rush to congratulate Colombia's winner. "We will wait for the count to finish — this is a preliminary count. We wait for the final tally, which could arrive in August, and then we will congratulate whoever obtained the victory." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, asked about Colombia's election Standard 4T foreign policy: non-intervention, respect for the host country's own process. While other capitals — especially north of the border — rush to bless preferred candidates, Mexico waits for the institutions to do their work.

🇲🇽⚖️ Tomato down to 19.51 pesos/kilo. Diesel and gas stable. Weekly Profeco price report: tomato prices dropped sharply after recent spikes. Fuel prices held steady. Finabien — the federal Welfare Bank's remittance service — once again topped the ranking for lowest cost to send money home from the US. "El jitomate bajó a 19.51 pesos por kilo en promedio nacional." — Iván Escalante Ruiz, Procurador Federal del Consumidor Profeco publishes the comparison every Monday to put pressure on retailers and orient consumers. Finabien was built specifically to break the monopoly of private remittance giants.
